tool.name: IQ-TREE 3
tool.description: Efficient phylogenomic inference by maximum likelihood
tool.command:
## Set up prefix for output files #set $prefix = 'iqtree_output'
iqtree -s '$alignment' -pre $prefix -T \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-4}
#if $general.st: -st $general.st #end if
#if $general.outgroup: -o '$general.outgroup' #end if
#if $general.seed: -seed $general.seed #end if
## Substitution model #if str($model.model_selector.model_selector) == "auto": -m $model.model_selector.model_auto #if $model.model_selector.mset: -mset '$model.model_selector.mset' #end if #if $model.model_selector.msub: -msub $model.model_selector.msub #end if #if $model.model_selector.mfreq: -mfreq '$model.model_selector.mfreq' #end if #if $model.model_selector.mrate: -mrate '$model.model_selector.mrate' #end if #if str($model.model_selector.cmin): -cmin $model.model_selector.cmin #end if #if str($model.model_selector.cmax): -cmax $model.model_selector.cmax #end if #if $model.model_selector.mtree: -mtree #end if #if $model.model_selector.madd: -madd '$model.model_selector.madd' #end if #else: -m '$model.model_selector.model_spec' #end if
## Partition model #if $partitions.partition_file: $partitions.partition_type '$partitions.partition_file' #end if
## Bootstrap / branch support #if $bootstrap.bootstrap_cond.bootstrap_type == "ufboot": -bb $bootstrap.bootstrap_cond.bb_replicates #if $bootstrap.bootstrap_cond.bnni: -bnni #end if #if str($bootstrap.bootstrap_cond.nm): -nm $bootstrap.bootstrap_cond.nm #end if #if str($bootstrap.bootstrap_cond.bcor): -bcor $bootstrap.bootstrap_cond.bcor #end if #if $bootstrap.bootstrap_cond.bsam: -bsam $bootstrap.bootstrap_cond.bsam #end if #elif $bootstrap.bootstrap_cond.bootstrap_type == "nonparam": -b $bootstrap.bootstrap_cond.b_replicates #elif $bootstrap.bootstrap_cond.bootstrap_type == "alrt": -alrt $bootstrap.bootstrap_cond.alrt_replicates #elif $bootstrap.bootstrap_cond.bootstrap_type == "alrt_ufboot": -alrt $bootstrap.bootstrap_cond.alrt_replicates -bb $bootstrap.bootstrap_cond.bb_replicates2 #end if
#if $bootstrap.abayes: -abayes #end if #if str($bootstrap.lbp): -lbp $bootstrap.lbp #end if
## Tree search options #if $tree_search.starting_tree: -t '$tree_search.starting_tree' #end if #if $tree_search.constraint_tree: -g '$tree_search.constraint_tree' #end if #if $tree_search.allnni: -allnni #end if #if $tree_search.fast: -fast #end if #if str($tree_search.nstop): -nstop $tree_search.nstop #end if #if str($tree_search.pers): -pers $tree_search.pers #end if #if str($tree_search.ninit): -ninit $tree_search.ninit #end if #if str($tree_search.ntop): -ntop $tree_search.ntop #end if #if str($tree_search.nbest): -nbest $tree_search.nbest #end if
## Advanced options #if $advanced.quiet: -quiet #end if #if $advanced.keep_ident: -keep-ident #end if #if $advanced.safe: -safe #end if #if $advanced.redo: -redo #end if #if str($advanced.blmin): -blmin $advanced.blmin #end if #if str($advanced.blmax): -blmax $advanced.blmax #end if #if $advanced.czb: -czb #end if #if $advanced.alninfo: -alninfo #end if
## Move output files to Galaxy dataset paths && cp $prefix.treefile '$treefile' 2>/dev/null || true && cp $prefix.iqtree '$report' 2>/dev/null || true #if $bootstrap.bootstrap_cond.bootstrap_type != "none": && cp $prefix.contree '$contree' 2>/dev/null || true #end if

param.name: model_selector
param.label: Model selection method
param.help: Choose automatic model selection or specify a model manually (-m)

param.name: model_auto
param.label: Model selection strategy
param.help: -m TEST / MFP etc.
param.option: TEST: Standard model selection + tree inference
MFP+MERGE: ModelFinder with partition merging + tree inference
MF+MERGE: ModelFinder with partition merging only
TESTMERGE: Standard selection with partition merging + tree inference
TESTMERGEONLY: Standard selection with partition merging only

param.name: mset
param.label: Restrict to model set
param.help: Comma-separated list of base models or a program name (raxml, phyml, mrbayes). E.g. WAG,LG,JTT (-mset)

param.name: msub
param.label: Restrict to AA model source
param.help: Restrict to AA models designed for a specific source (-msub)

param.name: mfreq
param.label: Frequency types
param.help: Comma-separated list of frequency types, e.g. FU,F (-mfreq)

param.name: mrate
param.label: Rate heterogeneity types
param.help: Comma-separated list, e.g. E,I,G,I+G,R (-mrate)

param.name: cmin
param.label: Min FreeRate categories
param.help: Minimum number of categories for FreeRate model (-cmin). Default: 2

param.name: cmax
param.label: Max FreeRate categories
param.help: Maximum number of categories for FreeRate model (-cmax). Default: 10

param.name: mtree
param.label: Full tree search for each model
param.help: Turn on full tree search for each model considered (-mtree). More accurate but slower

param.name: madd
param.label: Additional mixture models
param.help: Comma-separated list of mixture models to additionally consider, e.g. LG4M,LG4X (-madd)

param.name: model_spec
param.label: Model specification
param.help: Model string in the form MODEL+FreqType+RateType, e.g. GTR+I+G, LG+F+G, HKY+G (-m)

param.name: partition_file
param.label: Partition file
param.help: Partition file in NEXUS or RAxML-style format

param.name: partition_type
param.label: Partition model type
param.help: Type of partition model to use
param.option: Edge-equal (-q): all partitions share branch lengths
Edge-unlinked (-sp): each partition has own branch lengths

param.name: bootstrap_type
param.label: Bootstrap / branch support method
param.help: Choose a branch support method

param.name: bb_replicates
param.label: Number of UFBoot replicates
param.help: Recommended >= 1000 (-bb)

param.name: bnni
param.label: Optimize UFBoot trees by NNI
param.help: Recommended in the presence of severe model violations (-bnni)

param.name: nm
param.label: Max iterations
param.help: Maximum number of iterations to stop (-nm). Default: 1000

param.name: bcor
param.label: Min correlation coefficient
param.help: Minimum correlation coefficient for UFBoot convergence criterion (-bcor). Default: 0.99

param.name: bsam
param.label: Resampling strategy for partitioned analysis
param.help: Resampling strategy (-bsam)
param.option: GENESITE: resample partitions and sites within partitions

param.name: b_replicates
param.label: Number of bootstrap replicates
param.help: Recommended >= 100 (-b)

param.name: alrt_replicates
param.label: Number of SH-aLRT replicates
param.help: Recommended >= 1000 (-alrt). Use 0 for parametric aLRT

param.name: alrt_replicates
param.label: Number of SH-aLRT replicates
param.help: Recommended >= 1000 (-alrt)

param.name: bb_replicates2
param.label: Number of UFBoot replicates
param.help: Recommended >= 1000 (-bb)

param.name: abayes
param.label: Approximate Bayes test
param.help: Perform approximate Bayes test (-abayes)

param.name: lbp
param.label: Local bootstrap probability replicates
param.help: Number of replicates for local BP method (-lbp). Recommended >= 1000

param.name: starting_tree
param.label: Starting tree
param.help: File containing a starting tree for tree search (-t). Use BIONJ or RANDOM for built-in starting trees

param.name: constraint_tree
param.label: Constraint tree
param.help: Topological constraint tree in NEWICK format (-g)

param.name: allnni
param.label: Thorough NNI search
param.help: Consider all possible NNIs (-allnni). Slower but more thorough

param.name: fast
param.label: Fast tree search mode
param.help: Fast mode: only 2 starting trees optimized by NNI (-fast)

param.name: nstop
param.label: Unsuccessful iterations to stop
param.help: Number of unsuccessful iterations to stop (-nstop). Default: 100

param.name: pers
param.label: Perturbation strength
param.help: Perturbation strength for randomized NNI, between 0 and 1 (-pers). Default: 0.5

param.name: ninit
param.label: Number of initial parsimony trees
param.help: Number of initial parsimony trees (-ninit). Default: 100

param.name: ntop
param.label: Number of top initial trees
param.help: Number of top initial parsimony trees to optimize with NNI (-ntop). Default: 20

param.name: nbest
param.label: Number of candidate trees
param.help: Number of trees in the candidate set (-nbest). Default: 5

param.name: quiet
param.label: Quiet mode
param.help: Suppress printing to screen (-quiet). Log file is still written

param.name: keep_ident
param.label: Keep identical sequences
param.help: Keep identical sequences in the alignment (-keep-ident). By default they are removed and added back at the end

param.name: safe
param.label: Safe numerical mode
param.help: Avoid numerical underflow for large data sets (-safe)

param.name: redo
param.label: Redo entire analysis
param.help: Redo the entire analysis, overwriting existing output files (-redo)

param.name: blmin
param.label: Minimum branch length
param.help: Minimum branch length (-blmin). Default: the smaller of 0.000001 and 0.1/alignment_length

param.name: blmax
param.label: Maximum branch length
param.help: Maximum branch length (-blmax). Default: 10

param.name: czb
param.label: Collapse near-zero branches
param.help: Collapse near zero branches so the final tree may be multifurcating (-czb)

param.name: alninfo
param.label: Print alignment site statistics
param.help: Print alignment site statistics to .alninfo file (-alninfo)

tool.help:
**What it does**
IQ-TREE 3 is a software for phylogenomic inference using maximum likelihood and complex evolutionary models. It can reconstruct phylogenetic trees from DNA, protein, codon, binary, and morphological alignments, perform model selection (ModelFinder), and assess branch support via ultrafast bootstrap (UFBoot), SH-aLRT, and other methods.
**Key features**
- **Model selection**: Automatic selection of best-fit substitution models via ModelFinder (``-m MFP``), including FreeRate rate heterogeneity models. - **Tree inference**: Maximum-likelihood tree reconstruction with an efficient stochastic search algorithm. - **Branch support**: Ultrafast bootstrap (UFBoot, ``-bb``), SH-aLRT (``-alrt``), approximate Bayes (``-abayes``), local bootstrap probability (``-lbp``), and standard nonparametric bootstrap (``-b``). - **Partition models**: Support for edge-equal (``-q``), edge-proportional (``-spp``), and edge-unlinked (``-sp``) partition models. - **Constraint trees**: Topological constraint trees for guided tree search (``-g``).
**Usage**
1. Provide an alignment file in PHYLIP, FASTA, NEXUS, CLUSTAL, or MSF format. 2. Choose a substitution model: either let IQ-TREE select the best-fit model automatically (ModelFinder) or specify a model manually (e.g., ``GTR+I+G`` for DNA, ``LG+F+G`` for protein). 3. Optionally select a branch support method. For most analyses, SH-aLRT + UFBoot with 1000 replicates each is recommended. 4. Adjust tree search and advanced parameters as needed.
**Output files**
- **Tree file**: The best maximum-likelihood tree in NEWICK format (``.treefile``). - **Report file**: Detailed report with model parameters, log-likelihoods, and branch support values (``.iqtree``). - **Consensus tree**: Consensus tree from bootstrap analysis (``.contree``), only produced when a bootstrap method is selected.
**Model specification**
Models are specified as ``MODEL+FreqType+RateType``. Common examples:
- ``GTR+I+G``: General time-reversible model with invariable sites and Gamma rate heterogeneity (DNA). - ``LG+F+G``: Le-Gascuel model with empirical frequencies and Gamma rate heterogeneity (protein). - ``HKY+G``: Hasegawa-Kishino-Yano model with Gamma rate heterogeneity (DNA).
For more information, see the `IQ-TREE documentation <https://iqtree.github.io/doc/>`_.
